bullets.title: This Is How You Lose the Time War
bullets.creator: Amal El-Mohtar
bullets.note: ([@tithenai](https://twitter.com/tithenai?lang=en)) and [Max Gladstone](https://www.maxgladstone.com/) ([@maxgladstone](https://twitter.com/maxgladstone)). This fast fiction read has won just about everything: the Nebula Award for Best Novella of 2019, the 2020 Hugo Award for Best Novella, and more. DO NOT look at the Amazon description, any reviews, or any overviews of the plot. Just buy it and dive in. The less you know beforehand, the better, and its 150–190 pages will fly by. Try the first 20–30 pages, and you’ll see what I mean.

bullets.title: Remember to Remember: Take Away Lessons from My Interview with Tim Ferriss
bullets.creator: Dennis McKenna
bullets.note: ([@dennismckenna4](https://twitter.com/dennismckenna4?lang=en)). I found this article to be a powerful reminder of powerful reminders. Even if you never hear [our conversation](https://tim.blog/2021/07/21/dennis-mckenna/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf), this short read has tremendous value. **P.S.** I’m part of a related panel that has been submitted to SXSW. If you’d like to see it happen, [please upvote it here](https://panelpicker.sxsw.com/vote/114695). The video intro is somewhat odd, so if you watch it, you can skip ahead to the 40-second mark.
